quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: Every morning, Maria wakes up at six o'clock. She brushes her teeth and eats a quick breakfast. Then she walks her dog around the park before going to work.
options: A Simple Morning Routine Before Work
A Daily Dog Walk in the Park
Cooking a Big Dinner Every Night
Skipping Breakfast to Save Time
quests.correctAnswer: A Simple Morning Routine Before Work
quests.hint: Notice that Maria does three separate things each morning — a strong summary usually covers the whole set, not just one activity.
quests.explanation: Maria's morning includes three connected steps: waking up, eating, and walking the dog. A summary that names the full routine works better than one that focuses on only a single part of it.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: In Mr. Lee's class, students read a short story every Friday. After reading, they answer questions about the characters. Mr. Lee says this helps them understand stories better.
options: A Math Lesson Every Friday
A Weekly Reading Activity to Build Understanding
Students Writing Their Own Stories
A Class About Animal Habits
quests.correctAnswer: A Weekly Reading Activity to Build Understanding
quests.hint: Look at what the class does every Friday, and notice the reason Mr. Lee gives for doing it.
quests.explanation: This paragraph pairs a weekly classroom habit with its purpose — building understanding. The best summary names both the activity and the goal, not just a small detail like the questions.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: Tom works at a small bakery. He arrives at five in the morning to bake fresh bread. Customers line up early because they love the warm bread.
options: Long Lines at the Bakery Every Day
A Flower Shop on the Same Street
An Early Morning Baker Loved by Customers
Bread Baked Only on Weekends
quests.correctAnswer: An Early Morning Baker Loved by Customers
quests.hint: Pay attention to when Tom starts work and how customers feel about what he makes.
quests.explanation: Tom's early hours and the bread that draws customers in are two parts of the same idea: his effort and its result belong together in the summary.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: Last summer, the Garcia family drove to the beach. They packed sandwiches, towels, and a big umbrella. They spent the whole day swimming and building sand castles.
options: Packing Sandwiches and Towels for a Trip
A Family Ski Trip in the Mountains
Staying Home Because of Rain
A Family's Fun Day Trip to the Beach
quests.correctAnswer: A Family's Fun Day Trip to the Beach
quests.hint: The packing list is just preparation — look for what the family actually did once they got there.
quests.explanation: Packing is only the setup here. The real focus is the day itself — swimming and building sand castles — which makes that the heart of the summary, not the supply list.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: Grandma cooks a big lunch for the whole family every Sunday. Aunts, uncles, and cousins all come to her house. They eat, talk, and laugh together for hours.
options: Grandma Cooking Lunch Every Single Day
Cousins Meeting at a Restaurant
A Weekly Family Gathering at Grandma's House
A Quiet Lunch with No Visitors
quests.correctAnswer: A Weekly Family Gathering at Grandma's House
quests.hint: Notice how often this happens and how many relatives take part — both details matter for a complete summary.
quests.explanation: Because this gathering repeats every week and brings together aunts, uncles, and cousins, a good summary should mention both the regular schedule and the people involved.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: Before the trip, Sara made a shopping list. She bought new socks, a toothbrush, and a small bag. She checked every item off the list at the store.
options: Buying Only a New Toothbrush
Shopping for Travel Items on a Checklist
Selling Old Clothes at a Store
Forgetting the Shopping List at Home
quests.correctAnswer: Shopping for Travel Items on a Checklist
quests.hint: Think less about any single item on the list and more about the overall purpose of Sara's trip to the store.
quests.explanation: Sara's checklist is a tool for a bigger goal: getting ready for travel. The summary should describe the whole shopping trip rather than one item, like the toothbrush.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: On Saturdays, Ben helps his mother make pizza. They mix the dough, add cheese and tomatoes, and bake it in the oven. The kitchen smells wonderful when it is ready.
options: A Kitchen That Always Smells Wonderful
Ordering Pizza from a Restaurant
A Mother Who Only Bakes Bread
Making Homemade Pizza Together on Saturdays
quests.correctAnswer: Making Homemade Pizza Together on Saturdays
quests.hint: Look for who is involved, what they are making together, and which day this happens on.
quests.explanation: This paragraph highlights a shared Saturday activity between Ben and his mother, so the summary needs to include both people and the pizza-making itself.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: Jin got a new phone for his birthday. He learned how to take photos and send messages. His sister showed him how to download his favorite music app.
options: Learning a New Phone with a Sister's Help
A Sister Who Downloads Music for Herself
Buying a Phone as a Gift for a Sister
Already Knowing Every Phone Feature
quests.correctAnswer: Learning a New Phone with a Sister's Help
quests.hint: Consider what Jin received as a gift and who is helping him learn to use it.
quests.explanation: The gift and the learning process matter equally here, so a complete summary mentions both the new phone and the help Jin gets from his sister.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: Lina was coughing a lot, so her mother took her to the doctor. The doctor checked her throat and listened to her breathing. He told her to rest and drink warm tea.
options: A Doctor Who Only Checks Breathing
Lina's Mother Being the One Who Is Sick
Advice to Exercise More Often
A Doctor Visit for a Cough and Advice to Rest
quests.correctAnswer: A Doctor Visit for a Cough and Advice to Rest
quests.hint: Identify the reason for the visit and the advice the doctor gave afterward.
quests.explanation: Because the paragraph links Lina's symptom to the doctor's specific advice, the summary should cover both the reason for the visit and what she was told to do.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: On Friday night, the children watched a funny movie together. They made popcorn and turned off the lights. Everyone laughed at the silly jokes in the film.
options: Making Popcorn Before a Movie
A Sad Movie About Animals
A Fun Family Movie Night Full of Laughter
A Trip to the Cinema on Friday
quests.correctAnswer: A Fun Family Movie Night Full of Laughter
quests.hint: Consider the whole evening together rather than a single detail like the popcorn.
quests.explanation: This paragraph describes one full shared experience, so the summary works best when it captures the whole movie night instead of just one part of it.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: Aiden left a note for his roommate. It said, 'Gone to the gym, back by 7. Please feed the cat!' His roommate saw the note and fed the cat on time.
options: A Note Asking a Roommate to Feed the Cat
A Cat Fed at Exactly Seven O'Clock
A Note Asking a Roommate to Walk the Dog
A Roommate Who Never Saw the Note
quests.correctAnswer: A Note Asking a Roommate to Feed the Cat
quests.hint: Focus on what the note asked for, and notice whether that request was carried out.
quests.explanation: The note's purpose, and the fact that it worked, is the heart of this paragraph. A strong summary describes that request rather than a smaller detail like the exact time.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: Every evening, Mr. Park waters his small garden. He grows tomatoes, peppers, and herbs. He says fresh vegetables make his dinners taste much better.
options: Growing Only Tomatoes and Peppers
An Evening Garden Routine for Fresh Vegetables
Buying Vegetables from the Market Daily
Watering the Garden Only in Mornings
quests.correctAnswer: An Evening Garden Routine for Fresh Vegetables
quests.hint: Ask yourself when Mr. Park gardens and why he says he enjoys it so much.
quests.explanation: Because this paragraph connects a daily habit to a clear benefit, the summary should mention both the evening routine and the fresh vegetables it produces.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: The science teacher brought a small plant to class. Students took turns watering it and writing down how tall it grew. They learned that plants need water and sunlight.
options: Writing Down a Plant's Exact Height
A Teacher Who Brought a Small Animal
Learning About Plant Growth Through a Classroom Plant
Learning That Plants Do Not Need Water
quests.correctAnswer: Learning About Plant Growth Through a Classroom Plant
quests.hint: Look at what the class did with the plant and what that activity taught them.
quests.explanation: The hands-on activity and the lesson it teaches are two halves of one idea. Both belong in the summary, not just the detail about measuring the plant's height.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: Nora is a nurse at the city hospital. She checks on patients every hour and gives them their medicine. Her patients say she is always kind and patient.
options: Giving Medicine Only Once a Day
A Doctor Who Works at the Hospital
Patients Who Say She Is Impatient
A Caring Nurse Known for Her Kindness
quests.correctAnswer: A Caring Nurse Known for Her Kindness
quests.hint: Consider Nora's daily responsibilities as well as how her patients describe her.
quests.explanation: This paragraph combines a job description with a personal quality, so the strongest summary reflects both her duties and her reputation for kindness.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: Omar took the train to visit his cousin in another city. The trip took three hours, and he read a book the whole way. He was happy to see his cousin at the station.
options: A Long Train Trip to Visit a Cousin
Reading a Book for Only One Hour
Flying on a Plane to Visit a Cousin
A Cousin Who Visited Omar Instead
quests.correctAnswer: A Long Train Trip to Visit a Cousin
quests.hint: Notice both how Omar traveled and the reason he made the journey.
quests.explanation: The method of travel and its purpose, seeing family, are both part of the main idea, which is why a good summary keeps them together.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: Mia's little brother is learning to ride a bike. Mia holds the back of the bike and runs beside him. Every day, he rides a little farther without falling.
options: A Brother Who Rides Farther Each Day
A Sister Helping Her Brother Learn to Ride
A Sister Teaching Her Brother to Swim
A Brother Who Already Rides Perfectly
quests.correctAnswer: A Sister Helping Her Brother Learn to Ride
quests.hint: Identify who is teaching, who is learning, and what skill is being practiced.
quests.explanation: Since this paragraph is really about Mia's support for her brother, the summary should name both siblings and the skill, rather than focus only on his daily progress.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: The shoe store had a big sale this weekend. Many people lined up early to find good deals. Carlos bought two pairs of shoes for the price of one.
options: A Long Line Forming Early at a Store
A Shoe Store Closed for the Weekend
A Great Bargain at a Weekend Shoe Sale
Carlos Leaving the Sale Empty-Handed
quests.correctAnswer: A Great Bargain at a Weekend Shoe Sale
quests.hint: Picture the event happening at the store and what Carlos gained from it.
quests.explanation: The sale itself and the good deal Carlos found go hand in hand here — the strongest summary names the event and the bargain together.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: At the farmers market, Elena bought fresh strawberries, corn, and honey. She talked with the farmers about how they grew the food. She felt good knowing the food was fresh and local.
options: A Conversation About Growing Strawberries
Buying Fresh, Local Food at a Farmers Market
Buying Food at a Big Supermarket
Growing Strawberries at Home Instead
quests.correctAnswer: Buying Fresh, Local Food at a Farmers Market
quests.hint: Notice where Elena shopped and what kind of food she found there.
quests.explanation: This paragraph pairs a specific place with the type of food found there. The strongest summary mentions the market and the fresh, local produce together.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: David's laptop stopped working before his big presentation. He called his friend, who helped him fix it over video chat. David finished his presentation just in time.
options: A Friend's Help Fixing a Laptop Before a Presentation
Finishing a Presentation with Time to Spare
Buying a New Laptop the Next Day
A Friend Who Could Not Help
quests.correctAnswer: A Friend's Help Fixing a Laptop Before a Presentation
quests.hint: Look for the problem David faced and how it eventually got solved.
quests.explanation: This paragraph follows a clear problem-and-solution structure. The strongest summary connects the laptop trouble directly to the friend's help that fixed it.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: Coach Lopez tells the team to stretch before every practice. Stretching helps the players avoid injuries. The team now stretches for ten minutes before they start playing.
options: Ten Minutes of Practice Before Stretching
A Coach Who Tells Players to Skip Stretching
Stretching That Makes Players Play Worse
Stretching Before Practice to Prevent Injuries
quests.correctAnswer: Stretching Before Practice to Prevent Injuries
quests.hint: Consider why Coach Lopez introduced this habit, not just the habit itself.
quests.explanation: The stretching routine only makes full sense alongside its purpose. A good summary links the action to the reason behind it: preventing injuries.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: The town held a music festival in the park. Local bands played songs while families sat on blankets. Children danced near the stage while their parents clapped along.
options: Children Dancing Near the Stage Alone
A Festival Canceled Because of Rain
A Town's Music Festival Enjoyed by Families
A Festival Only Open to Adults
quests.correctAnswer: A Town's Music Festival Enjoyed by Families
quests.hint: Picture the whole event and who took part, rather than one small moment in the crowd.
quests.explanation: Because this paragraph describes a community-wide event, the summary should reflect the festival as a whole rather than a single detail like the children dancing.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: A sign at the library said, 'Quiet, Please: Study Area.' Students whispered instead of talking loudly. Staff reminded visitors to keep their phones on silent mode.
options: Staff Reminding Visitors to Talk Loudly
A Sign That Allows Loud Conversations
A Library with No Rules About Noise
A Library Sign Reminding Visitors to Stay Quiet
quests.correctAnswer: A Library Sign Reminding Visitors to Stay Quiet
quests.hint: Notice what the sign asks for and how visitors respond to it.
quests.explanation: The rule and the way people follow it are both part of this paragraph. Describing the sign's message together with its effect makes for the strongest summary.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: Hassan reads ten pages of a book every night before bed. He says it helps him relax and fall asleep faster. His favorite books are about space and adventure.
options: A Nightly Reading Habit That Helps Hassan Relax
Books About Space and Adventure Only
Reading in the Morning Instead of at Night
Reading That Keeps Hassan Awake Longer
quests.correctAnswer: A Nightly Reading Habit That Helps Hassan Relax
quests.hint: Pay attention to when Hassan reads and the effect it has on him, not just what he likes to read.
quests.explanation: This paragraph links a nightly habit to a specific benefit: relaxation. The best summary connects that timing with its effect, not just Hassan's favorite topics.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: Before the test, the teacher gave students a study guide. It listed all the important topics to review. Students who used the guide felt more confident during the test.
options: A List of Topics with No Other Purpose
A Study Guide That Helped Students Feel Ready
A Test That Was Canceled by the Teacher
Students Who Felt More Nervous After Using It
quests.correctAnswer: A Study Guide That Helped Students Feel Ready
quests.hint: Consider what the teacher provided and how it changed the way students felt about the test.
quests.explanation: Since the study guide and students' confidence are directly connected in this paragraph, the summary should mention both the tool and its positive effect.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: Priya manages a small coffee shop downtown. She orders supplies, trains new workers, and greets customers every morning. Regular customers say her shop always feels warm and friendly.
options: A Manager Known for a Warm, Friendly Coffee Shop
A Coffee Shop That Trains No New Workers
A Barista Who Works for Someone Else
Customers Who Say the Shop Feels Cold
quests.correctAnswer: A Manager Known for a Warm, Friendly Coffee Shop
quests.hint: Think about Priya's role at the shop and how customers describe the atmosphere there.
quests.explanation: This paragraph combines Priya's management duties with the shop's reputation. Linking her role to that warm, welcoming atmosphere makes for the strongest summary.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: Before flying, Yuki checked the weather and packed a warm jacket. At the airport, she showed her passport and boarding pass. She felt excited as she boarded the plane.
options: Packing Only a Warm Jacket
Missing a Flight at the Airport
Preparing for a Flight with Excitement
Feeling Nervous About Traveling
quests.correctAnswer: Preparing for a Flight with Excitement
quests.hint: Look at what Yuki did to get ready for the flight and how she felt about it.
quests.explanation: Preparation and emotion both matter here. The strongest summary reflects Yuki's steps before the flight together with her excitement about it.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: The Kim family takes a photo together every year on New Year's Day. They wear matching pajamas and smile for the camera. They keep all the photos in a special album.
options: Matching Pajamas Worn Every Day
Taking Photos Every Single Day of the Year
A Family That Stopped Taking Photos
A Yearly New Year's Photo Tradition
quests.correctAnswer: A Yearly New Year's Photo Tradition
quests.hint: Consider how often this happens and why it has become a meaningful custom for the family.
quests.explanation: Because this tradition repeats every year, the summary should highlight the yearly custom itself rather than a smaller detail like the matching pajamas.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: Liam forgot his wallet at the grocery store checkout. A kind cashier called him before he reached his car. Liam thanked her and gave her a small gift the next day.
options: A Gift Given the Next Day Only
A Cashier's Kindness After a Forgotten Wallet
A Wallet That Was Never Found
A Cashier Who Kept the Wallet
quests.correctAnswer: A Cashier's Kindness After a Forgotten Wallet
quests.hint: Identify the problem Liam had and who stepped in to help him.
quests.explanation: This paragraph follows a problem straight to its kind resolution. Connecting the forgotten wallet to the cashier's helpful action gives the fullest summary.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: Grandpa makes his famous soup every winter. He uses carrots, potatoes, and a secret spice. The whole family asks for the recipe, but he never shares it.
options: A Soup Made Only of Carrots
A Recipe Grandpa Shares with Everyone
A Soup Grandpa Makes Every Summer
Grandpa's Famous Winter Soup with a Secret Recipe
quests.correctAnswer: Grandpa's Famous Winter Soup with a Secret Recipe
quests.hint: Notice when Grandpa makes this dish and what makes the recipe so special.
quests.explanation: The seasonal dish and its secret recipe are both highlighted here. Mentioning the soup's popularity along with the mystery around it makes the summary complete.

quests.instruction: Choose the best summary for the paragraph.
quests.passage: Mei uses an app to learn new words every day. The app shows a word, a picture, and a short sentence. She has learned more than two hundred words this year.
options: An App That Shows Only Pictures
Daily Vocabulary Practice Using an App
Stopping the App After One Week
Learning the App's Name but No Words
quests.correctAnswer: Daily Vocabulary Practice Using an App
quests.hint: Look at what Mei does daily and the result she has achieved over the year.
quests.explanation: This paragraph tracks a daily habit through to its long-term outcome. Connecting Mei's consistent practice with her vocabulary growth is what makes the summary complete.
